newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR MAY 10 AND 11.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH/SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES FOR MAY 10 AND 11.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer fixtures for May 10 and 11:
Scottish premier division - Celtic v Dundee United, Hearts v Rangers, Kilmarnock v Aberdeen, Motherwell v Dunfermline, Raith v Hibernian.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v St Johnstone, Clydebank v East Fife, Dundee v Stirling, Falkirk v Greenock Morton, St Mirren v Partick.
Scottish division two - Berwick v Ayr, Brechin v Dumbarton, Hamilton v Livingston, Queen of the South v Clyde, Stranraer v Stenhousemuir.
Scottish division three - Alloa v Inverness, Cowdenbeath v Albion, East Stirling v Arbroath, Forfar v Queen's Park, Ross County v Montrose.

English premier league - Aston Villa v Southampton, Blackburn v Leicester, Derby v Arsenal, Everton v Chelsea, Leeds v Middlesbrough, Manchester United v West Ham, Newcastle v Nottingham Forest, Sheffield Wednesday v Liverpool, Tottenham v Coventry, Wimbledon v Sunderland.
